tirmidhi:2083.note: Ibn Abbas: visiting the sick (not at the time of death) and saying seven times: I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to cure you

bukhari:71.note: Muawiya; if Allah wants good for a person He gives him understanding of the religion

bukhari:2916.note: Aisha; the Prophet died with his iron armour mortgaged to a Jew for thirty sa of BARLEY (not wheat)

bukhari:3902.note: Ibn Abbas; revelation at forty, thirteen years in Makkah, ten in Madinah, died at sixty-three

bukhari:2509.note: Aisha; food bought on credit, armour mortgaged
